text_block_list.text:
I'm at the cafeteria deciding on what to
eat
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I notice Эйсин Флэш staring at all the
dishes on
display with a furrowed brow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The dish I am partial to here was
suddenly
removed from the menu today
due to supply
issues...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This has disrupted my planned food
intake and
has left me at a loss for what
to do.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Formulating a new menu plan now would
carry a
high risk of introducing extended
delays to the
rest of my scheduled
activities...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Why not take this chance to try something new?
Guess you'll have to think of something quickly.

text_block_list.text:
Formulating a new menu plan now would
carry a
high risk of introducing extended
delays to the
rest of my scheduled
activities...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Why not take this chance to try something new?
Guess you'll have to think of something quickly.

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you are correct. I shall use this

opportunity to expand the breadth of
my food
selection here.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That way, I will be able to create a
sub-plan to
deal with unexpected
occurrences like what
happened today.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
You might discover something unexpectedly
delicious too.

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If that is the case, perhaps this
change of
plans will be quite beneficial.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It is as you say. All that remains is for me
to
perform a swift reworking of my plan.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will check my planned nutritional
intake for
today and compare it to the
menu items that are
currently displayed.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
After thanking me, Эйсин Флэш returns
to
choosing a dish to eat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
